{{Top}}
A '''monad''' was a [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]-high, completely self-contained building complex that included hydroponics gardens and parks. Many of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] buildings were monads. [[Magra Monad]] was one such building and long with [[Kaldani Spires Residential Apartments]].
